title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
description: Find the smallest contiguous subarray whose sum is at least a target value.

data.text: Given an array `nums` and an integer `target`, return the minimal length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least `target`. If there is no such subarray, return `0`.
Build a prefix sum array. For each start index, binary-search the first end where the sum reaches target. O(n log n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: Prefix + Binary Search O(n log n)

data.text: Expand the right end, accumulating sum. When the sum is large enough, shrink the left end to find the smallest window. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Sliding Window O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n log n) → O(n). **Space:** O(n) → O(1). Sliding window is the standard pattern for minimum-length subarray problems because both pointers only move forward.
